events.title: Baseline day
events.detail: All four crew in the green. CRI 80-99.

events.title: Sleep deficit begins
events.detail: C002 sleeps under 6h. HRV starts to fall across the crew.

events.title: CRI low point
events.detail: C002 CRI falls to 61.7. Recovery plan starts.

events.title: Contingency EVA
events.detail: C003 + C004 outside for 3h 20m. SpO2 and heart rate watched live.

events.title: Solar particle event
events.detail: Radiation dose jumps to 1.32 mGy. Crew shelters in the shielded area. All-clear after 9 hours.

events.title: Recovery day 1
events.detail: Sleep protected, exercise cut. CRI climbs back for every crew member.

events.title: Back to green
events.detail: Whole crew GOOD or better. Mission summary ready for Ground.

/api/v1/crew/C001.notes: Highest CRP surge after landing (+107.3%). Steady recovery.

drivers.why: HRV 62.0 ms is below the 65 ms baseline — recovery is incomplete.

alerts.title: CRP up +107.3% after landing (L-3 to R+1)
alerts.why: C-reactive protein rose from 2.0 to 4.146 mg/L in the real OSD-575 lab samples. That is a strong inflammation signal after return to gravity.
actions: Recheck temperature and symptoms today
Log any pain, fever or fatigue in the daily check-in
Tell the Crew Medical Officer before the next EVA
Repeat the lab panel at R+7 if symptoms continue
alerts.escalation: Ground (flight surgeon) can answer in ~24 min round-trip at the earliest. Start these steps now, do not wait.

/api/v1/crew/C002.name: Crew C002
/api/v1/crew/C002.notes: Lowest CRI in the crew. 8 of 9 immune markers fell over 50% at R+1. Needs the most support.

drivers.why: HRV 46.0 ms is below the 65 ms baseline — recovery is incomplete.
Mood 5/10 — low mood drags resilience down.
Reaction 300.0 ms is slower than the 280 ms baseline — possible fatigue.

alerts.title: 8 of 9 immune markers fell over 50% at R+1
alerts.why: In the real OSD-575 samples almost the whole immune panel dropped sharply in the first day back in gravity. That pattern needs a medical officer review, not just watching.
actions: Crew Medical Officer review today
Hold strenuous exercise until reviewed
Repeat the panel at R+7 and compare
Log energy and appetite daily
alerts.escalation: Ground can answer in ~24 min round-trip. Start the review now.

alerts.title: Sleep only 5.9h on Sol 147
alerts.why: Sleep under 6 hours is the single biggest drag on the Crew Resilience Index.
actions: Protect the next sleep window — no late tasks
Dim lights 1 hour before sleep
Recheck tomorrow morning
alerts.escalation: No ground escalation needed unless it lasts 3 nights in a row.
